evidence: No workflow runs a dedicated secret-scanning tool (Gitleaks, TruffleHog, detect-secrets, ggshield) against source code via uses: or run:.
action_required: Add a workflow step invoking a secret scanner (e.g., gitleaks/gitleaks-action, trufflesecurity/trufflehog, or GitGuardian/ggshield) on push/PR.

evidence: No SAST scanner (CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarQube, Bandit) is executed in any workflow for the TypeScript/Bun codebase.
action_required: Add a SAST workflow (e.g., github/codeql-action or returntocorp/semgrep) triggered on push/PR.

evidence: No dependency vulnerability scanner (npm audit, Trivy, Grype, Snyk, OWASP Dependency-Check) runs in any workflow.
action_required: Add a dependency scanning step (e.g., npm audit, aquasecurity/trivy-action, or snyk/actions) in CI.

evidence: No workflow generates an SBOM (CycloneDX/SPDX) from package manifests (package.json, bun.lockb) using Syft, cdxgen, or equivalent.
action_required: Add an SBOM generation step (e.g., anchore/sbom-action or cyclonedx/github-action) in CI.

evidence: No source-level SBOM is generated, therefore no signing (cosign sign or in-toto attestation) occurs.
action_required: After implementing SEC-04, add a cosign sign step for the generated SBOM.

evidence: Multiple workflows reference actions by mutable tags: actions/checkout@v4 (auto-close-duplicates, backfill-duplicate-comments, issue-lifecycle-comment, sweep), anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 (claude-dedupe-issues, claude-issue-triage, claude), actions/github-script@v7 (lock-closed-issues, remove-autoclose-label). Only claude.yml and mod-tests.yml pin actions/checkout to a SHA.
action_required: Pin all third-party actions to full-length commit SHAs (e.g., actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683).

evidence: No fuzz testing workflow, fuzz/ directory, OSS-Fuzz config, or fuzzing tool invocation (libFuzzer, AFL++, go-fuzz, jsfuzz, ClusterFuzzLite) found.
action_required: Add fuzz testing for parsers/handlers of untrusted input (e.g., via OSS-Fuzz integration or a dedicated fuzz workflow).

evidence: Multiple workflows declare write permissions at the top level instead of job level: issue-lifecycle-comment.yml (issues: write), issue-opened-dispatch.yml (actions: write), lock-closed-issues.yml (issues: write), non-write-users-check.yml (pull-requests: write), remove-autoclose-label.yml (issues: write), sweep.yml (issues: write). Benchmark requires top-level permissions to default to read-only with write access scoped at job level.
action_required: Move all write permissions to job-level permissions blocks; set top-level permissions to read-only (contents: read) or omit.
